title: 书包里有什么？
quizName: What Is in the Schoolbag? Reading Quiz
lessonText: 书包里还有什么？还有黑色的……猫！

storyLang.pinyin: shū bāo lǐ yǒu shén me
shū bāo lǐ yǒu shén me

storyLang.english: There is a book in the schoolbag.
There is some paper in the schoolbag.

storyLang.pinyin: shū bāo lǐ yǒu qiān bǐ
storyLang.english: There is a pencil in the schoolbag.

storyLang.pinyin: shū bāo lǐ yǒu xiàng pí
storyLang.english: There is an eraser in the schoolbag.

storyLang.pinyin: shū bāo lǐ yǒu běn zi
storyLang.english: There is a notebook in the schoolbag.

storyLang.pinyin: shū bāo lǐ yǒu jiǎn dāo
storyLang.english: There are scissors in the schoolbag.

storyLang.pinyin: shū bāo lǐ hái yǒu shén me hái yǒu hēi sè de māo
storyLang.english: What else is in the schoolbag? There is also a black… cat!

questions.zh: 故事里，书包里先有什么？
questions.py: gù shì lǐ shū bāo lǐ xiān yǒu shén me
questions.en: What is the first item shown in the schoolbag?

questions.zh: 书包里有什么可以写字？
questions.py: shū bāo lǐ yǒu shén me kě yǐ xiě zì
questions.en: Which item in the schoolbag can be used to write?

questions.zh: 书包里有什么可以擦字？
questions.py: shū bāo lǐ yǒu shén me kě yǐ cā zì
questions.en: Which item in the schoolbag can erase writing?

questions.zh: 书包里有什么可以剪纸？
questions.py: shū bāo lǐ yǒu shén me kě yǐ jiǎn zhǐ
questions.en: Which item in the schoolbag can cut paper?

questions.zh: 故事里，蓝色的本子在哪里？
questions.py: gù shì lǐ lán sè de běn zi zài nǎ lǐ
questions.en: Where is the blue notebook in the story?

questions.py: shū bāo lǐ hái yǒu shén me dòng wù
questions.en: What animal is also in the schoolbag?

questions.zh: 故事里的猫是什么颜色？
questions.py: gù shì lǐ de māo shì shén me yán sè
questions.en: What color is the cat in the story?

questions.zh: 故事里，哪样东西没有出现在书包里？
questions.py: gù shì lǐ nǎ yàng dōng xī méi yǒu chū xiàn zài shū bāo lǐ
questions.en: Which item is not mentioned as being in the schoolbag?

questions.py: nǐ de shū bāo lǐ yǒu shén me
yòng shū bāo lǐ yǒu xiě jù zi
questions.en: Write a sentence using “There is/are … in the schoolbag.”

branches.en: There is a book in the schoolbag.
There is some paper in the schoolbag.
There is a pencil in the schoolbag.
There is an eraser in the schoolbag.
There is a notebook in the schoolbag.
There are scissors in the schoolbag.
There is also a black… cat!
